name: R W Smith

bio.statement: Smith's pamphlet statement lists work as a lean production manager, shop supervisor, arborist assistant and caregiver for individuals with disabilities.
bio.excerpt: Lean Production Manager, Shop Supervisor, Arborist Assistant, Caregiver for Individuals with Disabilities

bio.statement: Smith's pamphlet statement lists current service on the county Community Action Board and Community Climate Action Committee.
bio.excerpt: Clackamas County Community Action Board (current), Community Climate Action Committee (current)

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Smith opposes bringing large-scale data centers into Clackamas County.
positions.excerpt: I oppose bringing large-scale data centers into Clackamas County.

positions.statement: Smith's pamphlet statement says the county must stop wasting taxpayer dollars through poor planning and decisions made without public scrutiny.
positions.excerpt: We must stop wasting taxpayer dollars through poor planning and decisions made without public scrutiny.

positions.statement: Smith's pamphlet statement says he supports treatment for addiction and mental illness but insists on measurable outcomes.
positions.excerpt: I support treatment for addiction and mental illness, but I also insist on measurable outcomes.

positions.statement: Smith's pamphlet statement says families, farms and the environment must come before corporate demands.
positions.excerpt: Families, farms, and the environment must come before corporate demands.

positions.statement: Smith's campaign site says unhoused people should be moved off the streets into recovery-oriented care.
positions.excerpt: We must move unhoused neighbors off our streets and into recovery-oriented care.

positions.statement: In an OPB candidate questionnaire, Smith says the county should step in and reset expectations if ambulance response times are not met while costs rise.
positions.excerpt: If response times are not being met and costs are going up, the County needs to step in and reset expectations.

positions.statement: In the OPB questionnaire, Smith says the county should fund essential services, demand clear stewardship and show the public where the money goes.
positions.excerpt: Fund essential services, demand clear stewardship, and make sure the public can see where the money is going and why.

positions.statement: In the OPB questionnaire, Smith says people should be able to see how county decisions show up in their monthly bills.
positions.excerpt: People should be able to see how decisions made at the County level show up in their monthly bills.
